title: 서북도서방위사령부령 / queue:ADDENDUM:22974:20110615:00001:part:1/1
full_text:
ADDENDA <Presidential Decree No. 22974, Jun. 15, 2011>

Article 1 (Enforcement Date) This Decree enters into force on the date of its promulgation.

Article 2 (Amendment of Another Statute) The Regulations on Operational Units of Each Armed Service Whose Primary Mission Is Combat, etc. under Article 9 (3) of the Act on the Organization of the Armed Forces are partially amended as follows:

Subparagraph 2 of Article 2 is replaced with the following:

2. Navy

   Naval Operations Command, Marine Corps Command, and Northwestern Islands Defense Command.
